title: Business Security Deposit Recalculation Terms
content:
Held Security Deposits of the business kinds are recalculated at a set interval; the residential kinds are not. The terms for each kind are as follows.

| Security Deposit kind | Months between scheduled recalculations of a held deposit | Increase over the held amount that requires an additional deposit (fraction of the held amount) | Held cash above a lower recalculated amount refunded | Additional deposit due (calendar days after it is required) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential New Service Deposit | 0 (never recalculated) | 0 (no increase is required) | No | 0 |
| Residential Reestablishment Deposit | 0 (never recalculated) | 0 (no increase is required) | No | 0 |
| Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit | 0 (never recalculated) | 0 (no increase is required) | No | 0 |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | 24 | 0.25 (25%) | Yes | 10 |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | 12 | 0.20 (20%) | Yes | 10 |
| Large Power Service Deposit | 12 | 0.10 (10%) | Yes | 10 |

## Terms

- **Recalculation interval**: months between scheduled recalculations of the required amount on a held deposit; 0 means the deposit is never recalculated.
- **Increase threshold**: the increase of the recalculated amount over the held amount, as a fraction of the held amount, that triggers an additional deposit; 0 means no increase is required.
- **Excess refunded**: whether held cash above a lower recalculated amount is refunded.
- **Additional deposit due**: the calendar days after an additional deposit is required by which it is due.

## Worked threshold figures (hypothetical held amounts)

| Kind | Hypothetical held amount (USD) | Threshold fraction | Increase above which an additional deposit is triggered (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | 800.00 | 0.25 | 200.00 |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | 6000.00 | 0.20 | 1200.00 |
| Large Power Service Deposit | 90000.00 | 0.10 | 9000.00 |

For a hypothetical Medium Commercial Service Deposit required as an additional amount on 4 May, the additional amount is due 10 calendar days later, on 14 May.
